authorization: User requested assessment forecasts and NWM comparison, then prioritized the shortest qualified local path using saved weights. Bounded source staging separately approved.
selection: All saved final-development FULL L168 best-inner-stopping checkpoints; no favorable seed or architecture selection
availability_caveat: Simulated availability of revised historical observations; not verified historical publication times
weather: One eligible issued HRRR cycle covering all18 horizons, max age18h, no stitching
soil: Separately timestamped initial state, max age8h
spatial: Previously validated approximate independent basin footprints and frozen positive cell weights; no geometry change
input_admission: Complete original FULL L168 inputs only; no repairs or target-dependent admission
quality: Approved A or A+R only; exclude provisional, estimated and unrecognized qualifiers; preserve original qualifiers; no target filling
prediction: Raw physical m3/s, linear outputs, no clipping; retain negative-prediction frequency
prediction_barrier: Authenticate all36 complete prediction products before verification-role target assembly and scoring; inputs obey per-origin causality even when an observation is another origin's verification hour
primary_support: Input-admitted cases with all18 admissible verification targets, identical across all36 model products within gauge
secondary_support: Per-lead admissible targets among input-admitted origins; report separately from primary complete-H18 support
undefined_metrics: Explicit unavailable, never zero; do not drop undefined leads from primary mean
missing_predictions: Any absent or nonfinite prediction on input-admitted cases fails qualification; do not shrink support using predictions
seed_aggregation: Retain all3 results; arithmetic mean of seed metrics, descriptive min/max spread, no best-seed selection or prediction ensembling

nwm.role: External comparator only; never HYDRA predictor or eligibility requirement
nwm.product: Owned BigQuery short-range unique-record snapshot, ensemble0, already decoded m3/s
nwm.reference_time: Exact C-2h only; no older fallback
nwm.matching: Exact gauge, origin, valid-time keys; primary HYDRA support intersected only for paired reporting with finite available NWM values
nwm.summary: Separate equally weighted matched H1-16 means; never compare NWM16 mean against HYDRA18 primary mean
nwm.coverage: Report absent issues and invalid source values separately; saved BigQuery absence does not establish upstream NOAA absence
nwm.version_caveat: Sample native-file parity supports decoding; no archive-wide product-version or actual publication-time claim

uncertainty: First release is descriptive point metrics and seed variability only. Overlapping windows and event dependence preclude independent-case confidence claims. No new formal intervals or significance tests in this first pass.
